subject: Different parametrizations for baseline hazard in the Cox regression

messages.author: 281cea27474de3f0
messages.subject: Different parametrizations for baseline hazard in the Cox regression
parts:
In the coxph Cox model the baseline hazard is defined as being piecewice constant on user specified intervals. Is this the only model type that can be fit in INLA for baseline hazard in the Cox regression? 
Thank you,
Georgiana

messages.author: b453c29749de564d
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Different parametrizations for baseline hazard in the Cox regression
parts:
It's only pice wise constant. You can have a rw1 or rw2 interaction model between them, all though the rw2 does make less sense than rw1. 

H
